📧 Got Bible Questions? We’ve Got Answers!
Write to us at tv@sumtv.org, and your question could be featured in an upcoming Q&A episode! 🙏✨

QUESTION CHATPERS: 
1. (2:52) In 1 Corinthians 15 Paul speaks about Christ Resurrection from the dead And that those who have given their lives to Christ and are baptized into His death and shall be resurrected into His Life.
But I have run into some pseudo-Christian denominations that believe and practice baptism by proxy.
Meaning that their priests will perform a ceremony for the loved one of a dead person and with their "equipping" from the Holy Spirit 
They claim to have the power and authority to baptize the deceased person and believe that that newly baptized dead person will be there in the resurrection of the Righteous.
Can you please explain to them and everyone else that is deceived by this that this is not Biblical?
.
2. (11:03) What happened in 1888 in the Seventh-day Adventist church.
I.cant seem to understand what happened but it up in so many books of Ellen G. White.
